newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi says to unveil A6 at Geneva car show.
newsitem.headline: Audi says to unveil A6 at Geneva car show.

text.p: German carmaker Audi AG said on Wednesday that it would formally introduce its new A6 luxury saloon at the Geneva car show next month and would immediately begin selling the vehicle to customers.
Audi said it planned to produce about 60,000 of the new A6 vehicles in 1997 and would then boost yearly production to about 130,000 vehicles.
The new A6 sedan, aimed at competing against the BMW 5-series and the Mercedes E-Class vehicles, will cost between 50,400 marks ($29,900) and 71,900 marks based on engine type and options.
Audi said it would offer three engine options on the car -- a 2.8 litre six-cylinder engine, a 2.4 litre six-cylinder engine and a 1.8 litre four-cylinder turbo engine.
